ThermoPheno introduction

Source: vignettes/ThermoPheno-introduction.Rmd
ThermoPheno-introduction.Rmd

The bundled *_dummy_data.csv files contain synthetic weather for demonstrating the workflow. For an observed weather example, use the 2005 daily temperatures from DWD station 04709 (Simmern-Wahlbach). Source: Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD), Climate Data Center, CC BY 4.0. The extract selects one year and renames the date and temperature fields.

library(ThermoPheno)
path <- system.file("extdata", "dwd_simmern_wahlbach_2005.csv", package = "ThermoPheno")
head(prepare_weather(read.csv(path, colClasses = c(station = "character"))))
library(ThermoPheno)
weather <- prepare_weather(read.csv(system.file("extdata", "Germany_historical_1981_2010_dummy_data.csv", package = "ThermoPheno")))
params <- default_parameters("summer")
req <- estimate_required_tt(weather, 1981:2010, params$baseline_planting_mmdd, params$days_to_maturity, params$t_base, params$t_opt, params$t_max_cut, "triangular", "summer")
run_simulation(weather, params$crop_name, req$required_tt, params$earliest_planting_mmdd, params$latest_planting_mmdd, params$latest_harvest_mmdd, params$t_base, params$t_opt, params$t_max_cut, "triangular", "summer")

Calibrating from observed dates

estimate_required_tt_from_observed() derives the requirement from observed planting and harvest dates. By default (accumulation = "simulation"), each season is accumulated with the same rules the simulation uses after planting. Pass the same crop type and winter-crop rules as to the simulation, so that a simulation started on an observed planting date matures on the observed harvest date of that season.

wheat <- default_parameters("winter")
observed <- data.frame(
  crop_year = 1990:1992,
  observed_planting_date = as.Date(c("1989-10-05", "1990-10-08", "1991-10-03")),
  observed_harvest_date = as.Date(c("1990-08-01", "1991-08-05", "1992-07-28"))
)
req_obs <- estimate_required_tt_from_observed(
  weather, observed, calibration_years = 1990:1992,
  t_base = wheat$t_base, t_opt = wheat$t_opt, t_max_cut = wheat$t_max_cut,
  tt_mode = "triangular", crop_type = "winter",
  winter_dormancy_temp = wheat$winter_dormancy_temp,
  vernalization_required = wheat$vernalization_required,
  vernalization_days_required = wheat$vernalization_days_required,
  spring_regrowth_temp = wheat$spring_regrowth_temp
)
req_obs$required_tt

accumulation = "raw" sums daily thermal time without the winter-crop rules, as ThermoPheno 0.1.1 did. For winter crops with vernalization, a raw requirement is larger than the thermal time the simulation can accumulate over the same season, which makes simulated harvests late or forced at the deadline. For summer crops, both settings give the same values up to floating-point rounding.
